en: A card is tucked among the leaves, with an eye drawn on it in ink.
{player} found one of Looker's tickets!
text: O carte de vizită e strecurată printre frunze, cu un ochi desenat pe ea în cerneală.
{player} a găsit unul dintre biletele lui Looker!

en: A palm in a gilded pot. Even the plants here look expensive.
text: O palmă într-un ghiveci aurit. Până și plantele de aici arată scumpe.

en: Malva
So you're the Champion who keeps poking about in alleys. Anatole says you battle well. Let me see for myself.
text: Deci tu ești Campionul care tot scotocește prin alei. Anatole zice că lupți bine. Lasă-mă să văd singură.

en: Hmph. Fine. You've earned an answer.
text: Hmph. Fie. Ți-ai câștigat un răspuns.

en: The thief in the dark suit calls herself Essentia. She's your little friend Emma, in a suit that isn't hers.
text: Hoața în costum închis se numește Essentia. E mica ta prietenă Emma, într-un costum care nu e al ei.

en: A scientist of what's left of Team Flare made it. Xerosic. The suit takes orders from him, and so does whoever wears it.
text: L-a făcut un om de știință din ce a mai rămas din Team Flare. Xerosic. Costumul ascultă de ordinele lui, ca și cel care îl poartă.

en: I wanted no part of his tinkering. He's set up in Lysandre's old laboratory, under the café. The waiter knows the way.
text: N-am vrut să am de-a face cu ale lui. S-a instalat în vechiul laborator al lui Lysandre, sub cafenea. Chelnerul știe drumul.

en: Go and get your friend back, Champion. I'd go myself, but I have a reputation to keep.
text: Du-te și adu-ți prietena înapoi, Campionule. M-aș duce eu, dar am o reputație de păstrat.

en: Pardon me, but is that Pokédex full? Every last page! Allow me to shake your hand.
We who draw the Pokémon keep a few charms for those who see them all. Here, this is yours.
Fill in another Pokédex, in some other region, and come and find me. There may be another charm in it.
That diploma is for no region's list at all. It's for the Pokémon added beyond them!
You saw every one? I could use you to check my sketches.
All three of Kalos's Pokédexes, every page seen! The Central, the Coast and the Mountains.
Lumiose's painters would weep. I nearly am.
Several diplomas on one Pokédex? You must have seen more Pokémon than I have drawn.
Does your bag have room for anything but paper?
A diploma on your Pokédex! A whole region's list is a great many pages.
Kalos has three lists of its own. Fill them in and show me.
